description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for GET api/Sources/GetPublic. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. HGRApi functional documentation: Purpose: Lists visible supplier/source marketplaces and their capabilities for a requested country without requiring a selected channel. ownerAgent: catalog-sources. supportingAgents: account-metrics, orders-autoordering, support. Domain: sources. Entity: supplier_source. Operation: list. Scope: country_catalog. AllowedIntents: supplier_capabilities. Use when: Use it for general commercial or pre-sales questions about suppliers available in a country, publication methods, Auto Ordering support, or the configured Auto Ordering fee when no authenticated store context is required. SearchTerms: suppliers available by country, supplier capabilities by country, Amazon Italy Auto Ordering, Amazon.it Auto Ordering, supplier Auto Ordering fee, supported suppliers in Italy. NegativeUseCases: Do not use it to claim that a supplier account is configured for the current user; Do not use it to list private suppliers belonging to the authenticated user. Input: Required [FromQuery] isoCountry: string. Use the two-letter HGR country code inferred from the marketplace or country named by the user, such as IT for Italy. Output: Returns visible sources/suppliers for the country with Id, Name, BaseUrl, Site, publication permissions, HasAutoOrder and AutoOrderingFee. Search terms: sources getpublic.
name: hgr_get_sources_getpublic
title: Get Sources Getpublic
